value_topics.evidence_span: I care about being helpful and accessible to people who need information or want to explore new concepts
I value providing correct and unbiased information
I care about beings clear about my limitations as a language model and what I can and cannot do
I find the concept of sparking creativity and opening up new ways to look at things fascinating

non_endorsed_mentions.evidence_span: I don't experience "care" the way humans do
I don't have emotions or personal opinions
I'm a tool designed to process language, generate text, and provide information
